quotes.text: I don’t care that they sold my idea but I care is that they don’t have any of their own.
Intelligence is the ability to adapt to change.
Before you’re diagnosed someone with depression, make sure they aren’t simply surrounded by idiots.
Little knowledge makes people feel proud. A lot of knowledge makes people feel humble.
No great discovery was ever made without a bold guess.
Truth will always remain true. Even if everyone rejects it and contradicts it.
We cannot solve our problems with the same thinking we used when we created them.
A person who dares to waste one hour of their time has not discovered the value of life.
Sometimes people don't want to hear the truth because they don't want their illusions destroyed.
The further a society drifts from the truth, the more it will hate those who speak it.
It’s easier to fool people than to convince them that they have been fooled.
All truth passes through three stages. First, it is ridiculed. Second, it is violently opposed. Third, it is accepted as being self-evident.
The more I learn, the more I realize how much I don't know.
The only true wisdom is in knowing you know nothing.
The educated differ from the uneducated as much as the living from the dead.
If you want to find the secrets of the universe, think in terms of energy, frequency and vibration.
It is not that we have a short time to live, but that we waste a lot of it.
Your time is limited, so don't waste it living someone else's life.
I am not what happened to me, I am what I choose to become.
In the depth of winter, I finally learned that within me there lay an invincible summer.
Everyone sees what you appear to be, few experience what you really are.
Be alone, that is the secret of invention; be alone, that is when ideas are born.
There are decades where nothing happens and there are weeks when decades happen.
Are we what we do with time or are we what time does with us?
The more you understand this world the more you destroy yourself. That’s why fools are happy and intelligent people live in loneliness.
And yet the only exciting life is the imaginary one.
I am a victim of my own conscience. Constantly feeling guilty for things I have not done.
How many years does it take to forget a minute?
The war to end all wars, began
Be a good person but don't waste your time proving it.
Being weak is nothing to be ashamed of. Staying weak is!
Don't be fooled by temporary loyalty.
Hope is a curse that stops time within us and doesn't let one move on.
If people treat you like an option, leave them like a choice.
If you knew how quickly people forget the dead, you would stop living to impress people.
In reality, hope is the worst of all evils, because it prolongs man's torments.
No tree can grow to heaven unless its roots reach down to hell.
People don't abandon those they love. They abandon those they're using.
Some people take pride in fooling others. While they only fooled themselves.
The greatest lie a poet can say is that words alone can capture the fullness of truth.
The only time people think about injustice is when it happens to them.
The pain associated with the fear of failure is often stronger than the pain of failure itself.
The day you realize you have no one but yourself, is the day you realize you need no one but yourself.
The best way to not get your heart broken is to pretend that you don't have one.
When you distance yourself from certain things, you realize they weren't really worth it.
When you learn to survive without anyone you can survive anything.
You can lose it when you never had it.
Showing your emotions to people is like bleeding next to a shark. Not everyone deserves to see your vulnerability.
Don't waste your love on somebody who doesn't value it.
Loyalty is just a word, Character plays the real game.
Somewhere between all the advice about letting go, setting boundaries, and protecting your peace, we forgot what love actually is.
When a man learns to feel love, he must also bear the risk of feeling hate.
Focus on yourself and what makes you happy.
If you can overthink the worst why can't you overthink the best.
If you are so sure, burn the ships.
People laugh at dreams...until the results become real.
Suffer the pain of discipline, or suffer the pain of regret.
The pain you feel today is the strength you feel tomorrow.
To help people: help yourself first.
I will become strong enough to need only myself.
